name: OmaCombat
author: leewynne
description: Upcoming UFC and MMA fight cards in your bar, with ONE Championship (ONE FC), the PFL and the big boxing fights a click away: a countdown to the next UFC event and a popup that steps through every card, with records and live results. Formerly Next UFC.

barWidget.description: Countdown to the next UFC event, with the full fight card, arrows to browse the events after it, and tabs for ONE Championship, the PFL and the big boxing fights coming up.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: fighters: Gane vs. Hokit · 6d. icon: the glove alone, filled with your theme's urgent colour while an event is live.

schema.label: Fight times
schema.description: Times are always shown in your local time zone. locale follows the system's time format.

schema.label: ONE Championship
schema.description: Which ONE events the panel's ONE tab lists. all: every event. big: skips the weekly ONE Friday Fights. off: hide the tab.

schema.label: PFL
schema.description: Show the panel's PFL tab, with every PFL event on ESPN's schedule.

schema.label: Boxing
schema.description: Which boxing cards the panel's Boxing tab lists. big: ESPN's key dates. titles: every card with a world title fight. all: ESPN's full schedule. off: hide the tab.

schema.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: Polls every 2 minutes while an event is live, regardless of this setting.
